stem:
The lengths, $X$ centimetres, of a random sample of 7 leaves from a certain variety of tree are as follows.

$$5.2 \qquad 4.8 \qquad 5.5 \qquad 6.1 \qquad 4.8 \qquad 3.9 \qquad 4.4$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance of $X$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: It is now given that the true value of the population variance of $X$ is 0.55, and that $X$ has a normal distribution.
parts.text: Find a 95% confidence interval for the population mean of $X$.
